title: Fixed Four Blank Windows and Finger Loop Tally Counter
description: One newly authored complete static handheld tally-counter exterior. A whole rounded flat-bottom housing has one genuine shallow front recess, four complete opaque blank readout pads and three full dividing bridges. One complete top plunger stem and broad cap, a full side reset-knob exterior and a complete rear oval finger loop on two whole mounts remain attached to that housing. All numerical geometry new, not a cropped meter with probes removed or a compact mirror with extra buttons. Three opaque constant PBR roles, metres Z up and whole bounds-centred ground datum. One original model zero scenes; the four blank readout pads are parts, not separate assets. Empty illustrative game art only: no digits, indicated count, real counter mechanism, actuation, reset, finger fit, loading, durability, manufacture or safety capability. No rigging animation or interaction.
